en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, multi‑storey historic building with decorative gables and a balcony, identified on the facade as a restaurant. It stands along a wide road bordered by trees and an old streetlamp; in the distance are more buildings and wooded hills. Two children are visible on the roadside. The printed caption at the top identifies the location as Coswig i. S. – Spitzgrundmühle, and there is German text on the building front.
